financial_documents_batch_paid_check.name: financial_documents_batch_paid_check
financial_documents_batch_paid_check.value: "financial_documents"."commission_settlement_id" is null or "financial_documents"."commission_paid_at" is not null

receipts_reversal_reason_check.name: receipts_reversal_reason_check
receipts_reversal_reason_check.value:
(
    ("receipts"."reverses_receipt_id" is null and "receipts"."reason" is null) or
    ("receipts"."reverses_receipt_id" is not null and "receipts"."reason" is not null and length(trim("receipts"."reason")) between 1 and 500)
  )

commission_deductions_amount_check.name: commission_deductions_amount_check
commission_deductions_amount_check.value:
"commission_deductions"."amount_cents" > 0 and "commission_deductions"."quantity" > 0 and
    ("commission_deductions"."unit_amount_cents" is null or ("commission_deductions"."unit_amount_cents" > 0 and "commission_deductions"."amount_cents" = "commission_deductions"."quantity"::bigint * "commission_deductions"."unit_amount_cents"))

expenses_unit_amount_check.name: expenses_unit_amount_check
expenses_unit_amount_check.value:
(
    ("expenses"."unit_amount_cents" is null and "expenses"."quantity" = 1) or
    ("expenses"."unit_amount_cents" is not null and "expenses"."unit_amount_cents" > 0 and "expenses"."amount_cents" = "expenses"."quantity"::bigint * "expenses"."unit_amount_cents")
  )

expenses_payment_check.name: expenses_payment_check
expenses_payment_check.value:
("expenses"."status" = 'PAID' and "expenses"."paid_at" is not null and "expenses"."payment_method" is not null)
    or ("expenses"."status" in ('PENDING','OVERDUE') and "expenses"."paid_at" is null and "expenses"."payment_method" is null)

inventory_movements_sale_check.name: inventory_movements_sale_check
inventory_movements_sale_check.value:
("inventory_movements"."movement_type" = 'SALE_OUT') = ("inventory_movements"."payment_method" is not null)
    and ("inventory_movements"."payment_method" is null or "inventory_movements"."payment_method" in ('CASH','PIX','DEBIT_CARD','CREDIT_CARD','TRANSFER','OTHER'))

work_schedules_working_hours_chk.name: work_schedules_working_hours_chk
work_schedules_working_hours_chk.value: ("work_schedules"."is_working_day" = false AND "work_schedules"."start_time" IS NULL AND "work_schedules"."end_time" IS NULL AND "work_schedules"."break_start" IS NULL AND "work_schedules"."break_end" IS NULL) OR ("work_schedules"."is_working_day" = true AND "work_schedules"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "work_schedules"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "work_schedules"."end_time" > "work_schedules"."start_time")

work_schedules_break_hours_chk.name: work_schedules_break_hours_chk
work_schedules_break_hours_chk.value: ("work_schedules"."break_start" IS NULL AND "work_schedules"."break_end" IS NULL) OR ("work_schedules"."break_start" IS NOT NULL AND "work_schedules"."break_end" IS NOT NULL AND "work_schedules"."break_start" > "work_schedules"."start_time" AND "work_schedules"."break_end" > "work_schedules"."break_start" AND "work_schedules"."break_end" < "work_schedules"."end_time")
